notes.title: Devlog2: The story mode is currently under development!
notes.content:
Hello everyone!

It has been quite a long time since the last Devlog update. In the past few months, "Eaves" has created a brand-new gameplay mode.

[h2]Story mode[/h2]

The brand new story mode, allows players to enter a world called "Gui Meng" as a Apprentice God of Fate, leading various lost souls, using "Xi Rang" to help the souls fulfill their wishes, understand the secrets of the soul, uncover its identity, and obtain new Xi Rang and rewards.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43723738/c7dd4fc2896b709dee544613091b606c4b993ef7.jpg[/img]
In addition to being able to use "Xi Rang" to build the world you want, players can also manipulate souls and freely explore the world of Gui Meng, enjoying the world you have built.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43723738/202efe743c4958dda10e0a9e71c568ed9c0e2ffc.jpg[/img]
We have prepared some screenshots so that you can understand the current progress of the game. Of course, everything is still under development, and the screenshots do not show the final effect.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43723738/6bc3af57065ba11df1fa274a73aebf0ac477ba1e.jpg[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43723738/ace1cfaec04034c839a6af6fcc29f8a999a8e518.jpg[/img]
The new demo is also being developed intensively. If you don't want to miss the latest news of "Eaves", please add the game to your wishlist.

Thank you for your support!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1897300/_/
